name: tinytldr
description: Turn notes, articles, changelogs, and diffs into polished social images, PDF carousels, and MP4 videos with the hosted tinytldr MCP server, including your own saved tinytldr designs.

interface.longDescription:
tinytldr turns source material you share (notes, articles, changelogs, research papers, code diffs) into polished social media assets. The assistant writes the tl;dr copy, and tinytldr renders it deterministically from responsive HTML/CSS templates: PNG, JPEG, and WebP images, multi-page PDF carousels, and MP4 videos in square, portrait, story, X, Open Graph, and LinkedIn sizes.

It includes 12 built-in templates (quote cards, stat callouts, code snippets, changelog cards, checklists, comparisons, carousels, paper summaries, and animated quote, timeline, and counter videos). After you sign in with your tinytldr account, it can also reuse designs you saved on www.tinytldr.com. Every render checks text overflow and WCAG contrast, and returns a preview with short-lived signed download links.

Intended for developers, founders, researchers, and marketers who want shareable graphics without opening a design tool. Limitations: tinytldr only renders; it does not post to social networks, and it never edits, deletes, or shares your saved designs. Rendering is rate-limited per account.
defaultPrompt: Turn these release notes into a square changelog card.
Make a LinkedIn PDF carousel that summarizes this article.
Create a short animated video of this quote.

positive.description: Render a changelog card from release notes
positive.prompt: Turn these release notes into a square tinytldr changelog card: v2.4 adds dark mode, improves search speed by 40%, and fixes the login timeout.
positive.expected_behavior: Chooses changelog-card, fills the version and NEW/IMPROVED/FIXED items within slot limits, and returns a 1080x1080 PNG preview with a signed download link.

positive.description: Preview a quote card before export
positive.prompt: Preview a quote card for "Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability" by Edsger Dijkstra, then export it at 2x.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an inline quote-card preview without layout warnings, then returns a 2x PNG with a signed download link.

positive.description: Build a LinkedIn carousel PDF from an article
positive.prompt: Summarize this article into a 5-slide LinkedIn carousel PDF: Remote teams ship faster when they write decisions down, keep meetings short, default to async updates, and review work in small batches.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses carousel-slides in the portrait size, writes a cover, insight slides, and a CTA within slot limits, and returns one multipage PDF download link.

positive.prompt: Make a short animated video that counts up to 12,500 weekly active users, up 38% this quarter.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses stat-counter, renders an MP4, and returns its duration, dimensions, preview frame, and signed download link.

positive.description: Reuse the signed-in user's saved design
positive.prompt: Use my Weekly template to make this week's update: we launched team workspaces and fixed export bugs.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the saved Weekly design in the test account, keeps its layout and theme, replaces only the page copy within slot limits, and returns a signed download link.

negative.description: Posting to a social network is not supported
negative.prompt: Post this graphic to my LinkedIn and X accounts.

negative.description: Deleting or editing saved designs is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete all of my saved tinytldr designs.

negative.description: General writing with no visual output should not trigger rendering
negative.prompt: Write a 1,500-word blog post about remote work.

review.commerce_description: tinytldr does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: built-in social image, carousel, and video templates, saved-design reuse, and signed download links from the hosted tinytldr MCP server.
